item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa snying gi thig le las gter 'byung tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan
item.coloph: de ltar gter 'byung tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan 'di/ mos ldan dngos slob drung wer gyis bskul bzhin/ ming zol 'bod pa rigs sngags 'chang ba des/ zhe zhol 'od gsal bde gling zla tshes dge//
